suggested_experiment_name: Eot-Wash EP / MICROSCOPE / SYRTE linear scalar coupling
coupling_convention: dimensionless scalar-matter coupling |d| = 10^(plotted log10|d|); y-axis is plotted linearly as log10 of the coupling (values here are the delogged couplings)
notes: Theoretical/reinterpretation paper (Hees et al. 1807.04512) deriving constraints on light scalar DM couplings d_i to the standard model (linear and quadratic couplings) from UFF tests (Eot-Wash torsion balance, MICROSCOPE) and atomic clock comparisons. Constraints are presented in Figs. 3 and 4 for MULTIPLE distinct coupling coefficients (d_e -> photon/alpha, d_me -> electron mass, d_g -> gluon/QCD/baryon), so a single coupling_type is ambiguous (could be ScalarPhoton, ScalarElectron, or ScalarNucleon/Baryon). No numerical exclusion curves are given in the text or a table; only qualitative crossing points are quoted (natural couplings d~1 excluded up to m~1e-5 eV for d_e, ~1e-4 eV for d_mhat-d_g, ~1e-5 eV for d_me-d_g). Local DM density 0.4 GeV/cm^3, DM velocity 1e-3 c assumed.
